description.zh: 备份过期时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 >- 9999-01-01T00:00:00Z 表示长久保留。 >- 只能延长备份保留时间，不可缩短。 >- 当设置的时间不是 9999-01-01T00:00:00Z 时，必须在备份集结束时间之后的 730 天范围内。
description.en:
The time-to-live (TTL) of the backup. The time must be in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

> - *9999-01-01*T*00:00:00*Z* indicates that the backup is retained permanently.*
>
>   *- You can only extend the retention period. You cannot shorten it.- If you do not set the time to *9999-01-01*T*00:00:00*Z, the new expiration time must be within 730 days after the end time of the backup set.*
>
> **

title.zh: 修改MongoDB备份集的过期时间

descriptions.zh:
仅支持修改手动备份的过期时间。

仅支持修改云盘版MongoDB实例。
descriptions.en:
You can modify the TTL only for manual backups.

This operation is applicable only to MongoDB instances that use cloud disks.
